independent_answer: 9 Dutch Americans sat at the windows.
check: There were 90 × 3/5 = 54 Dutch people, of whom 54 × 1/2 = 27 were American; 27 × 1/3 = 9 got window seats. The solution uses 1/5 instead of 3/5 in its first step.
error_description: The first step incorrectly counts only one fifth of the passengers as Dutch, omitting the factor of 3. This leads to the incorrect final answer of 3.
